queues.title: Market identity and boundaries
queues.objective: Define platform functions, products, buyers and history

tasks.title: Identify the legal operator
tasks.acceptance: Public official evidence names the operator and date.

tasks.title: Classify all platform roles
tasks.acceptance: Separate selling, publishing, payment, discovery and contracting roles.

tasks.title: Map products and services
tasks.acceptance: Document permitted and excluded classes of offerings.

tasks.title: Define seller and buyer segments
tasks.acceptance: Describe who supplies and who pays in each segment.

tasks.title: Record changes in marketplace structure
tasks.acceptance: Cite dated launches, acquisitions and economic changes.

queues.title: Entry and eligibility
queues.objective: Understand who can participate and what it takes

tasks.title: Document onboarding
tasks.acceptance: Identify signup steps and eligibility documents.

tasks.title: Verify country and residency access
tasks.acceptance: Compare official rules by jurisdiction.

tasks.title: Record age, identity and tax requirements
tasks.acceptance: State requirements and their geographic scope.

tasks.title: Check thresholds and curation
tasks.acceptance: Document review processes, audience thresholds and approvals.

tasks.title: Measure time to earning eligibility
tasks.acceptance: Use official timings or dated samples with caveats.

tasks.title: Identify practical barriers
tasks.acceptance: Examine credentials, tools, languages and platform-specific conditions.

tasks.title: List setup and publication costs
tasks.acceptance: Record mandatory, optional and recurring charges.

tasks.title: Find commissions and service fees
tasks.acceptance: State fee basis, rate, tiers and effective dates.

tasks.title: Separate payment processing charges
tasks.acceptance: Check transaction, currency conversion, refund and chargeback costs.

tasks.title: Check payout rails and countries
tasks.acceptance: Document payment methods and geographic availability.

tasks.title: Record withdrawal minimums and delays
tasks.acceptance: State payout minimum, frequency, holds and reserve policies.

tasks.title: Identify published tax obligations
tasks.acceptance: Document required forms, withholding and merchant-of-record terms.

tasks.title: Model a transparent net-sale example
tasks.acceptance: Calculate gross less documented fees with assumptions.

tasks.title: Build a dated fee and payout history
tasks.acceptance: Compare sourced changes without overwriting previous rules.

queues.title: Market size and demand
queues.objective: Measure buyers, sellers, segments and growth

tasks.title: Estimate reachable buyer populations
tasks.acceptance: Define geography, date and measurement method.

tasks.title: Estimate active versus total sellers
tasks.acceptance: Separate registered, listed, active and paid users.

tasks.title: Measure transaction or revenue scale
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish GMV, platform sales, revenue and payouts.

tasks.title: Identify meaningful product segments
tasks.acceptance: Use a reproducible category taxonomy.

tasks.title: Establish comparable growth series
tasks.acceptance: Compare consistently defined observations over time.

tasks.title: Assess market concentration
tasks.acceptance: Measure dependence on leading categories or sellers.

queues.title: Discovery and acquisition
queues.objective: Understand how demand reaches an offering

tasks.title: Document platform search and recommendation
tasks.acceptance: Cite discoverability surfaces, ranking documentation and limits.

tasks.title: Research evidence of query demand
tasks.acceptance: Record public demand signals and their sample limitations.

tasks.title: Map external acquisition channels
tasks.acceptance: Compare search, social, referral, newsletters and paid traffic.

tasks.title: Specify the acquisition funnel
tasks.acceptance: Define impressions, click-through, visits, leads, conversion and purchase.

tasks.title: Examine seasonality
tasks.acceptance: Compare like periods or mark the pattern unknown.

tasks.title: Track changes to distribution rules
tasks.acceptance: Date and source important ranking or policy updates.

queues.title: Competition and prices
queues.objective: Study the actual field and how sellers differentiate

tasks.title: Define comparable competitor sample
tasks.acceptance: Record sampling query, category, time and selection method.

tasks.title: Measure comparable price distributions
tasks.acceptance: Report sampled price ranges, currency and denominator.

tasks.title: Assess differentiating features
tasks.acceptance: Identify observable features without equating ratings with quality.

tasks.title: Assess reputation and incumbent advantage
tasks.acceptance: Study rankings, reviews, follower counts or legacy position.

tasks.title: Review buyer and creator switching costs
tasks.acceptance: Document lock-in, export, reviews and transferability.

tasks.title: Identify testable market gaps
tasks.acceptance: Write falsifiable needs and niche hypotheses.

tasks.title: Define earning-population denominator
tasks.acceptance: Separate all users, active sellers and paid sellers.

tasks.title: Find representative mean earnings
tasks.acceptance: Include amount, currency, period, sample and bias or mark unknown.

tasks.title: Find representative median earnings
tasks.acceptance: Include zero earners and method or mark unknown.

tasks.title: Document earnings percentiles
tasks.acceptance: Seek p10, p25, p75, p90 and top-tail evidence.

tasks.title: Study share earning zero
tasks.acceptance: State who is counted and why the measure may be biased.

tasks.title: Audit selection and survivorship biases
tasks.acceptance: Describe recruitment, response bias and missing populations.

tasks.title: Estimate effort-adjusted earnings
tasks.acceptance: Count production, marketing, administration and support time.

tasks.title: Separate sales, payout and net profit
tasks.acceptance: Define each economic quantity and all known expenses.

tasks.title: Check intellectual property terms
tasks.acceptance: Document license grants, owner rights and source dates.

tasks.title: Check exclusivity and restrictions
tasks.acceptance: State duration, geography and affected rights.

tasks.title: Document product acceptance and bans
tasks.acceptance: Identify current content/product rules with evidence.

tasks.title: Study portability of content and audience
tasks.acceptance: Record exports, email access, ratings and account limits.

tasks.title: Review dispute, appeal and takedown paths
tasks.acceptance: Document official procedures and timing.

tasks.title: Check rights to reuse research inputs
tasks.acceptance: Verify copyright, API and database licensing constraints.

tasks.title: Inspect listing and offer structure
tasks.acceptance: Document metadata, images, tags and pricing controls.

tasks.title: Trace sale or contract flow
tasks.acceptance: Describe transaction steps and who collects payment.

tasks.title: Study refunds and disputes
tasks.acceptance: Identify who bears losses and processing charges.

tasks.title: Document buyer feedback mechanisms
tasks.acceptance: Describe ratings, reviews, moderation and reputation transfer.

tasks.title: Study repeat and recurring purchases
tasks.acceptance: Define retention, subscriptions, renewal and churn measurements.

tasks.title: List seller analytics
tasks.acceptance: Identify reported conversion and traffic metrics, access and gaps.

queues.title: Risk, policy and continuity
queues.objective: Identify ways revenue and access can fail

tasks.title: Study suspension and termination
tasks.acceptance: Record policy grounds and appeals.

tasks.title: Document common fraud and payment risks
tasks.acceptance: Distinguish official warnings and independently observed incidents.

tasks.title: Track economically meaningful policy revisions
tasks.acceptance: Record version and effective date of rule changes.

tasks.title: Measure single-platform dependency
tasks.acceptance: Assess portable audience, payment and customer relationships.

tasks.title: Study privacy and data-access requirements
tasks.acceptance: Record official limits and risks to creator data.

tasks.title: Check country-specific compliance
tasks.acceptance: State sources and jurisdiction without invented legal advice.

tasks.title: Model continuity and exit options
tasks.acceptance: Document data export, payouts at closure and alternatives.

queues.title: Strategies and earning experiments
queues.objective: Find and test realistic ways to earn

tasks.title: Enumerate viable earning pathways
tasks.acceptance: Connect offering, audience, promotion, payment and fulfillment.

tasks.title: Compare neighboring marketplaces
tasks.acceptance: Use consistent cost, reach, rights and risk terms.

tasks.title: Model bounded revenue scenarios
tasks.acceptance: State assumptions; never invent likelihoods or expected earnings.

tasks.title: Calculate break-even conditions
tasks.acceptance: Include fixed costs, time, variable fees and refunds.

tasks.title: Specify testable offer experiments
tasks.acceptance: Define variant, cost, audience and evaluation threshold.

tasks.title: Specify acquisition experiments
tasks.acceptance: Measure traffic, conversions, time and cash costs.

tasks.title: Specify retention tests
tasks.acceptance: Define reorders, subscriptions, churn and horizon.

tasks.title: Write evidence-bounded recommendation
tasks.acceptance: State who may benefit, uncertainties, risks and next test.

tasks.title: Finish public source register
tasks.acceptance: Every factual claim links to dated attributed public evidence.

tasks.title: Cross-check critical claims
tasks.acceptance: Use independent sources or document why cross-check unavailable.

tasks.title: Audit unknowns and comparability
tasks.acceptance: Inspect denominators, missing data and misleading comparisons.

tasks.title: Review all public artifacts
tasks.acceptance: Verify rights, privacy, neutral tone and data suitability.

tasks.title: Write the readable marketplace dossier
tasks.acceptance: Summarize fees, outcomes, barriers and uncertainty in plain English.

tasks.title: Validate index, dossier and queue references
tasks.acceptance: Ensure schema and gallery render checks pass.

tasks.title: Set a maintenance schedule
tasks.acceptance: Select review dates based on fee, policy and payout volatility.

tasks.title: Serial versus book formats
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for serial versus book formats.

tasks.title: First publication and adaptation rights
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for first publication and adaptation rights.

tasks.title: Chapter schedules and reader retention
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for chapter schedules and reader retention.

tasks.title: Advances, royalties and subscription income
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for advances, royalties and subscription income.

tasks.title: Cover, metadata and cross-platform discovery
tasks.acceptance: Collect dated public evidence and document implications for cover, metadata and cross-platform discovery.
